title: GitLab

hostname.label: GitLab hostname
hostname.help: Hostname only, for example github.com or gitlab.example.com. No https:// prefix, path or port. Host login must match this hostname.

help: Provides glab CLI/API access for merge requests, issues and GitLab repositories. SSH is independent.
On the host: glab auth login --hostname gitlab.com (use your hostname for self-hosted GitLab).
Alternatively provide GITLAB_TOKEN to the launching process. Never save token values in JSON.
Check login yourself on the host: glab auth status --hostname gitlab.com.
For an SSH Git remote, also enable SSH and register your public key with that GitLab host.
